note: Modern campground of Hartwick Pines State Park (9,335 acres, with the old-growth pines) near Grayling. Sites 1-64 have 20/30-amp electric with shared water spigots; sites 65-100 are full hookup with 50-amp. Trails from the campground to Bright and Glory lakes and a spur to the park's mountain-bike trails. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: 100 sites, 50-amp full hookup at 65-100, every site to 40 ft (max_rig_ft new), pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/two-lane dump, reservable on MiDNRReservations. Fees 41-51 (2026 table) -> 43-58 (2027 booking site; 2026 full hookup is $56 there vs $51 in the table). Season (derived year-round) left: no page states it. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Phone missing: the DNR park page gives 989-348-7068 (reservations 800-447-2757).

Season: the entry's derived year_round: true (from note prose) is not stated on any DNR page read. The rates table gives a reservation season of May 1 - October 31 for Hartwick Pines Campground (shower building 'Available for all reservable season'), and the park page tags only the rustic cabin, not the modern campground, with 'Winter camping or lodging'. A reservation season is not a campground season, so nothing was changed; a human may want to confirm winter camping.
Fees conflict: for 2026 the booking site quotes the full-hookup sites at $56 (2026-10-27) while the DNR rates table lists $51; the 2027 booking-site rates ($43 / $58) were recorded.
